verdict.rationale: Hugging Face's first-party docs describe Inference Providers as a drop-in replacement for the OpenAI chat completions API: you swap the base URL and use a single token. Providers can also be chosen through model-id suffixes, so an agent can switch to or away from Hugging Face without provider-specific code. Tool use is also documented on the chat-completion endpoint. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of drop-in compatibility, and documented detail on parity gaps such as streaming or parameter differences versus OpenAI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent switch to or away from this provider mid-workflow because it speaks the standard chat-completions API without provider-specific code changes

citations.quote: Drop-in replacement for the OpenAI chat completions API.
Just swap-out the base URL to instantly access hundreds of additional open-weights models through our provider network.
You can also select the provider of your choice by appending the provider name to the model id (e.g. `"openai/gpt-oss-120b:groq"`).
